This leaks validation-fold labels into the OOF matrix that is then used to fit the meta-learner and tune the threshold, biasing the reported 'Final Validation Score' and threshold selection. I will fix this by drawing an inner validation split from the training fold for early stopping so the OOF fold is never seen during training.",

                xc_tr_s,
                xn_tr,
                y_int[tr],
                cards,
                epochs=epochs,
                seed=seed + fi * 10 + b,
                val=(xc_va_s, xn_va, y_va.astype(np.float32)),
                coupon_field_idx=coupon_field_idx,
                gate_dropout=float(ARCH["gate_dropout"]),
            )
=======
        coupon_field_idx = find_coupon_field_idx(spec)
        p_sum = np.zeros(len(va), dtype=np.float64)
        inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed + fi)
        inner_tr, inner_va = next(inner_skf.split(xc_tr_s, y_int[tr]))
        for b in range(bag):
            m = train_deepfm(
                xc_tr_s[inner_tr],
                xn_tr[inner_tr],
                y_int[tr][inner_tr],
                cards,
                epochs=epochs,
                seed=seed + fi * 10 + b,
                val=(
                    xc_tr_s[inner_va],
                    xn_tr[inner_va],
                    y_int[tr][inner_va].astype(np.float32),
                ),
                coupon_field_idx=coupon_field_idx,
                gate_dropout=float(ARCH["gate_dropout"]),
            )
>>>>>>> REPLACE"
